summary: Track browser pageviews and typed product events through PostHog, with buffered initialization and analytics disabled when no key is configured.
description: Collect browser pageviews and explicitly named product events through one typed analytics module. Events can queue while PostHog initializes, and an empty key makes analytics silent in development and tests. Session recording and autocapture are off by default; consent and cookie use are explicit choices. The guidance excludes user-entered text, email addresses and tokens. It does not establish legal compliance or provide server-side analytics.
seoDescription: PostHog browser analytics with typed events, buffered initialization and a silent no-key state for development and tests.

projectExamples.title: Article interaction measurement

projectExamples.title: Dashboard workflow measurement
projectExamples.description: Instrument custom React interactions through the typed event catalog. Record internal identifiers only where appropriate, and keep form contents out of events.

plain.whatItIs: Adds PostHog, an analytics service, to a web app to record page views and a fixed list of named user actions.
goodAt: Tracking chosen actions, such as an article being shared, in the browser
Running tests and local development without an analytics account or key
Guidance against sending typed text or email addresses in events
notGoodAt: Server-side analytics or error tracking; those need separate tools.
